text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The first of the Classic Triple Crown races, the Satsuki Sho, is finally here, and the air at the Nakayama Racecourse is electric.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: …Anyway, that's basically how I think things will go. I mean, what else could happen, really?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I dunno. Eishin Flash has really polished up her game lately…

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: But you've got her down in a really low placement. She's got a strong following, so what gives?

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: I get where you're coming from. She seems pretty strong, she's making a name for herself… but c'mon!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: This is the Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: So this is the Classic Triple Crown… This is the Satsuki Sho… The crowd is deafening.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Even the air itself feels different from the previous races I've run. The pressure coming from the other racers is incredible…
choice_data_list: But the track is still the same.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Precisely. I know the Nakayama Racecourse well thanks to my participation in the Keisei Hai.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: This is the race where only the fastest shall prevail… I have already determined the optimal time to unleash my top speed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: All that's left is to execute my strategy as usual. I shall see you in thirty minutes.
